purpose: Development replay on already-exposed failed pilot cases; not independent evaluation or learned-controller improvement
policy: fixed sequential tool loop; rejected learned proposal not enabled
rules: Use issue text and base tracked source only; no reference/evaluator patches or solution links.
Keep failed attempts and do not extend the budget after seeing results.
Run official scoring only after each frozen prediction.
Report retrieval time, total candidate wall time, model tokens/calls, and outcomes; no net-efficiency claim.
A fresh independent sample is required before stronger performance claims.
